rationale: The inner One Wilshire polygon is not a campus: its OSM history changed it from a commercial building to building:part=yes, and it carries the same 624 South Grand Avenue address, 30 levels, 120-meter height, and data-center use as the parent One Wilshire building. Preserve the source object as superseded and redirect it to the building facility.

The intersecting objects are separate sites. OSM history identifies the Lumen building at 215 East Indian School Road and the campus boundary as building=no at 4010 North 3rd Street; 4010 Data Center independently identifies that address as its multi-building PHX02/PHX04 campus. Do not assign the Lumen building to the 4010 campus.
